about: Modwerk source-only improved-performance package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/improved-performance.

mods.title: Improved Performance
mods.summary: The audio engine leaves out work whose result it already knows, so the same pattern uses less CPU and the screen and keys answer faster. A CPU mark shows when the load gets close to the limit.
mods.description: Stock computes nearly everything in every audio block, whether it is used or not: all eight sample voices, every send, the delay and the reverb, every modulation pass. Improved Performance tests, block by block, whether a piece of that work can change anything, and leaves it out when it cannot: sample voices that play nothing, sends at zero, a silent delay or reverb, modulation with nothing to modulate, parameters that are not moving, the USB audio input when nothing streams. The output is stock's bit for bit, but for one thing: a delay or reverb that has died away below -114 dBFS and has no input is given exact silence. With the time saved the unit redraws and reads its keys sooner, and a busy pattern keeps further from dropouts. CPU appears in the lower right corner of the bottom status bar while the audio load is close to the limit, and OVR while it is over.
mods.author: npp1993
mods.on_unit: This package's source ran on the author's Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74 from RAM as IP06, beside 17 other modules on his development base, hands off: one pattern's audio load 72.1 % of the block against 85.4 % without the module; self-checking builds of the engine code counted 0 differences against stock. Two small changes to the CPU/OVR drawing after IP06 ran in rytm-emu only. This package's bytes have not been flashed from the site.
